recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is for FHIR-12426. If FHIR-55563 is later applied to the main current build, handle Contract removal under that later tracker rather than reopening this DSTU2 status request.
issue_request: FHIR-12426 was a Published/Persuasive Financial Management DSTU2 change request asking to add .status to Contract.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-12426 was found. The apparent initial application is the untagged 2016-12-04 commit da5d903460e24a552b3c487b1fd8a513ca7a6c7e, created shortly after the Jira issue, which added Contract.status as a 0..1 code element with a ContractStatus required binding to the historical Contract spreadsheet source. Later Contract source refactors preserved the element in source/contract/structuredefinition-Contract.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini includes contract=Contract and marks Contract approved, so the Contract source is in current build scope. The current StructureDefinition defines Contract.status as a 0..1 code modifier/summary element with a required binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/contract-status, and source/contract contains the matching Contract status CodeSystem and ValueSet. FHIR-9561 is an earlier Published/Persuasive same-change-family request for a Contract status element. FHIR-55563 later proposes moving Contract out of R6 normative scope, but it is only Resolved - change required in this run scope and its removal commit is not on the current worker or combined branch. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active source already satisfies the seed request.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published/Persuasive request that Contract should have a status element, satisfied by the same current Contract.status source. It was cited as supporting context but not independently decided in this worker.

Later Resolved - change required request to remove/move Contract from R6 normative scope; its removal commit is not on the current worker or combined branch, so it does not supersede this current-source audit.
